context.title: Vista Chamber of Commerce: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Vista Unified School District — Measure N (Vista Unified School District School Improvement Bond of 2026)

positions.statement: Rachel Beld (President & CEO, Vista Chamber of Commerce) signed the argument in favor of Vista Unified School District Measure N in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
